prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night just after rain on a 1930s street outside a shop window full of loaves under a plain blank sign: two crowds of working people, young and old, men and women, Black, white and South Asian, half in red scarves and half in blue scarves, frozen mid-shove, fists still raised, and every head turning slowly the same way, towards the shop, where an emerald glow rises from a pavement grating at its door. Plain red and blue banners with no writing hang forgotten. The street lamp, the small red moon, wet cobbles. Most of the frame in shadow; the brightest values are the green glow and the lamp. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
